title: Daily Digest A: Injury Watch (Thu Nov 19)
parts:
🩹 DEVYDOSE INJURY WATCH | Thu, Nov 19

The SEC's first availability reports for Saturday are out: Vanderbilt's 5⭐ freshman QB is off the list, Florida's 5⭐ sophomore WR is still on it, and two LSU receivers are question marks for Tennessee 🧵👇

✅ JARED CURTIS | Vanderbilt | FR, 5⭐ | #66 QB

Not on Vanderbilt's SEC injury report for Florida after an undisclosed injury against Alabama (via The Tennessean).

Clark Lea had said after that game that Curtis got banged up.

🩹 VERNELL BROWN III | Florida | SO, 5⭐ | #10 WR

Listed out for the Vanderbilt game on the SEC report (via The Tennessean).

He opened the year #6 WR in the Alpha Draft Signal.

🐯 LSU at Tennessee (via Tiger Rag)

🩹 Winston Watkins | LSU | SO, 4⭐ | #14 WR: questionable. A thumb injury from the Kentucky game has limited him.

🩹 Jackson Harris | LSU | SR | #62 WR: questionable.

Whose status are you watching Saturday? 👇
